mapper.select: select version_id from ${tableName} where biz_key = #{bizKey} and content_hash = #{contentHash}
mapper.insert: insert into ${tableName} (biz_key, content_hash, payload, ${c.column}, first_sync_time, last_sync_time, hit_count) values (#{v.bizKey}, #{v.contentHash}, #{v.payload}, #{c.value}, sysdate(), sysdate(), 1)
mapper.update: update ${tableName} set last_sync_time = sysdate(), hit_count = hit_count + 1 where version_id = #{versionId}
mapper.insert: insert into option_resource_sync (resource_key, biz_key, http_status, result, version_id, raw_bytes, cost_ms, message, trigger_type, sync_time) values (#{resourceKey}, #{bizKey}, #{httpStatus}, #{result}, #{versionId}, #{rawBytes}, #{costMs}, #{message}, #{triggerType}, sysdate())
